Account offers focus

the drag moves the slider to the right end

checks.observed: COPPER LANTERN 52 | Account harbor-pilot Passcode CIYYYYYYYYYY Y Signin | A State: volume 100 Row 6 …

the first painted word starts where it is painted (16 px in, ±10 px)

checks.check: the capture is the window's
the tree stage finds the canvas without text

the PNG decodes to the reported size
the display capture is the session's display size
the screenshot shows the fixture

a window capture is the window's size
record: a finalized MP4 of the reported size
record: duration about 3 s (2.5 s .. 4.5 s)
record-start returns a recording in progress
record-stop finalizes it
before the timer the wait expires (negative control)
the wait resolves on the dialog
it resolves after the timer, not before
the dialog's window is enumerated
the session does not exist before the start (negative control)
session-start returns a running headless session

its record is gone

the fixture is gone with it
its runtime directory is gone
